name: sb
description: See which of your parallel Claude Code sessions in tmux are waiting on you, get a macOS notification when one is, and jump to it from a picker.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Post a macOS notification when a session waits on you and you are not looking at it.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Load the walnut-and-brass tmux theme. Off keeps your own status bar and colours.

code_links.title: Links to code
code_links.description: Have Claude write references to code as links that open the file at that line.

ticket_links.title: Links to tickets
ticket_links.description: Have Claude write references to tracker tickets and projects as links titled with their name.

terminal_app.title: Terminal app
terminal_app.description: The macOS app that runs tmux, as the Dock names it. Used to tell whether you are looking at a pane, and to bring it forward when you click a notification.

tracker.title: Tracker
tracker.description: Where /sb:shape-tickets stores tickets: as files kept by the plugin, or in Linear.

linear_team.title: Linear team
linear_team.description: The Linear team key tickets go to, such as ENG. Only used when Tracker is linear.

max_stack_layers.title: Stack depth
max_stack_layers.description: The most tickets one stack of dependent PRs may hold, built by one worker. A longer chain splits into several stacks.
